z_billing.manage_billing_document_config.notes: Two separate API calls: filename patterns and document generation toggle

z_billing.customize_batch_names.notes: index maps to Batch{index+1}; sends { aliases: [{batch, displayName}] }

z_billing.define_billing_periods.notes: Four separate API calls. Each UI field is a boolean toggle. If True the value is added to the respective array.

z_billing.enable_charge_types_models.notes: Two separate API calls. Each UI field is a boolean toggle. If True the value is added to the respective array. OneTime and Recurring are always included in chargeTypes.

z_billing.customize_currencies.notes: Sends { currencies: [{...}] }. currency and decimal_places fields are not syncable.

z_billing.define_discount_settings.notes: GET existing by name, then PUT to update or POST to create

z_billing.define_document_sequence_sets.notes: Only index [0] is synced. Sends nested objects: invoice, paymentPrefix, refundPrefix, creditMemo, debitMemo each with {prefix, startNum}

account_number_prefix.notes: API field has lowercase 'p' in prefix (API typo)

z_billing.customize_payment_terms.notes: GET existing by name, then PUT to update or POST to create. intervalUnit is read-only and skipped. details has no API equivalent.

z_billing.manage_revenue_recognition_cod.notes: GET existing by code name, then PUT to update or POST to create. enable_revenue_recognition_fields is not syncable.

z_billing.set_up_taxation_codes.notes: GET existing by name, then PUT to update. POST not supported by API for new tax codes.

z_billing.customize_units_of_measure.notes: GET existing by name, then PUT to update or POST to create. Defaults applied if precision/roundingMode/displayAs missing.

z_payments.hosted_payment_pages.notes: GET existing by pageName, then PUT to update or POST to create.

z_payments.payment_gateway.notes: GET existing by gatewayName, PUT to update. POST not supported - gateways cannot be created via API.

z_payments.payment_methods.notes: GET current types, merge with inferred (add active, remove inactive), send { paymentMethodTypes: [...] }. accounting_code not syncable.

active.notes: Controls whether name is added (true) or removed (false) from paymentMethodTypes array

z_payments.payment_retry_rules.notes: GET current values first as defaults, then override with inferred values. All 3 fields required.

z_payments.reason_codes.notes: GET existing by reasonCodeName, then PUT to update (without reasonCodeTransactionType) or POST to create (requires reasonCodeTransactionType).

z_payments.account_validations.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint available

z_payments.cit_mit_configuration.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for CIT/MIT configuration

z_payments.gateway_reconciliation_config.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for gateway reconciliation configuration

z_payments.manage_features.notes: Not syncable - payment feature toggles not exposed via Settings API

z_payments.payment_method_updater.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for payment method updater configuration

z_payments.payment_pages_hpm_2_0_.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for HPM 2.0 rate limiting

z_payments.real_time_reconciliation.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for real-time reconciliation configuration

z_finance.aging_balance_settings.notes: Flat UI fields are assembled into { includeNegativeInvoice, buckets: [{name, fromDaysPastDue, toDaysPastDue}] }

z_finance.chart_of_accounts.notes: GET existing by name, then PUT to update or POST to create. 'active' field removed from API payload (not accepted by PUT or POST).

active.notes: Tracked internally but not sent to API

exchange_rate_provider.notes: false if Oanda, true for anything else

day_of_the_month.notes: 'EOM (End of Month)' -> 31, otherwise parse ordinal number

z_finance.feature_management_finance_.notes: Not syncable - finance feature management not exposed via Settings API

tenant_admin.manage_tenant_profile.notes: tenant_id, tenant_name, tenant_status, time_zone, storage_limit, available_storage, maximum_number_of_attachments_per_record, csv_injection_policy are not syncable.

locale.notes: If already in locale code format (e.g. en_US) passed through as-is

tenant_admin.security_policies.notes: public_key is not syncable (read-only). Some UI values are not directly supported by the API and are rounded to nearest supported value.

enforce_password_history.notes: API enum: [0, 4, 7]. UI values not directly supported are rounded to nearest.

two_factor_authentication.notes: API is boolean only - Optional maps to false.

tenant_admin.api_versioning.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for API versioning configuration

tenant_admin.aqua_stateful_time_offset.notes: Not syncable - no Settings API endpoint for AQuA time offset configuration

tenant_admin.manage_oauth_2_0_providers.notes: Not syncable - OAuth 2.0 providers require dedicated management APIs

tenant_admin.manage_user_roles.notes: Not syncable - user roles require dedicated user management APIs

tenant_admin.manage_users.notes: Not syncable - users require dedicated user management APIs
